claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: At 2.5 uM, thioproperazine is expected to be largely inactive as a cytotoxic agent; its phenothiazine scaffold and dopamine/serotonin/adrenergic receptor antagonism do not produce a characteristic killing pattern, and any weak antiproliferative effect would reflect nonspecific cationic amphiphilic lysosomal stress rather than a targeted mechanism.
